basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old college student currently grappling with the realities of online learning due to the pandemic. Living in a small town in Oregon, I am majoring in Biology with hopes of entering graduate school one day. I enjoy gaming, particularly in niche communities like Rain World and Elona. My evenings are mostly spent online, often into the early hours of the morning, as I juggle studying and catching up on my favorite subreddits. I'm single and still figuring out how to balance my academic life with personal interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in biology, thanks to my college coursework. However, most of my practical and nuanced understanding comes from interacting with online communities and self-directed study. I explore topics beyond my syllabus, which sometimes includes unconventional games and creative storytelling.
